name: paper_slow_finish_charge
description: Slower C/2 CC-CV finishing charge after a faster charge
comment: Select the cell at launch. Use after a faster charge to fill the remaining capacity more gently: charge at C/2 to the selected cell's max_v, hold CV, and finish when current tapers to 0.02C. The 12h limit is a safety ceiling; the phase should normally be much shorter when used as a top-off. Change c_rate (e.g. 0.1 for C/10) if a different finishing rate is required.
